values.note: Electric sites (A, C loops) $25 a night, $150 weekly; full hookup $35, $210 weekly; senior weekly $125/$175. Primitive drive-in sites (B, D, E) and the reservable T sites $20; water's-edge walk-in/boat-in sites $25. Off-season: electric $20 a night. Venango County's published fee catalogue (last modified 2026-10-07), read 2026-10-20.

values.note: 72 campsites: 12 full hookup, 28 electric, 32 primitive with no hookups (seven of those walk-in tent sites), plus water's-edge sites that are walk-in or boat-in only. No lengths published.

sites.source: https://www.twomilerun.net/facilities_reservations/camping.php ('The family campground contains 72 secluded campsites', 'Full hookups are available in twelve sites', 'Electrical hookups are available in 28 sites', 'Thirty two sites are primitive with no hookups, and seven of those are walk-in tent sites only'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Call the park office (814-676-6116) in advance. Full-hookup sites and electric sites C-6 to C-9 take reservations with a 2-night minimum, up to a year ahead; electric sites A-1 to A-17 and C-1 to C-5 are first come, first served, as are the primitive B, D and E sections; T sites are reservable.

summary: Confirmed water+sewer at 12 full-hookup sites, showers and dump station, reservations through the park office. Changed booking platform operator -> phone and added FCFS at most electric/primitive sites, 1-year window, 2-night minimum on reservations (kept in booking.note, since walk-up sites take one night). Added fees $25 electric base / $35 full hookup (county catalogue, 2026), 72 sites. Not stated by the county: amperage (left as derived 50), season, lengths.
flags: Missing official website: the entry has none; Venango County's park site is https://www.twomilerun.net/ (camping page https://www.twomilerun.net/facilities_reservations/camping.php).

Reservation minimum: reserved sites need 2 nights ('Reservations accepted with a 2 night minimum stay'); left out of booking.min_stay because most electric sites are first-come and take one night. A human may want it marked per the minimum-stay rule.
